006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import java.util.HashMap;
009import java.util.Map;
010import java.util.concurrent.locks.Lock;
011import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReadWriteLock;
012import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;
013import java.util.stream.Stream;
014
015import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
016import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
017import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
018import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
019
020/**
021 * Provides a catalog of registered function implementations.
022 * <p>
023 * Functions can be registered using the {@link #registerFunction(IFunction)}
024 * method.
025 * <p>
026 * Previously registered functions can be looked up using the
027 * {@link #getFunction(IEnhancedQName, int)} method.
028 */
029public class FunctionLibrary implements IFunctionLibrary {
030
031  @NonNull
032  private final Map<IEnhancedQName, NamedFunctionSet> libraryByQName = new HashMap<>(); // NOPMD - intentional
033  @NonNull
034  private final ReadWriteLock instanceLock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
035
036  /**
037   * Register the provided function signature.
038   *
039   * @param function
040   *          the function signature to register
041   * @throws IllegalArgumentException
042   *           if the provided function has the same arity as a previously
043   *           registered function with the same name
044   */
045  public final void registerFunction(@NonNull IFunction function) {
046    registerFunctionByQName(function);
047  }
048
049  private void registerFunctionByQName(@NonNull IFunction function) {
050    IEnhancedQName qname = function.getQName();
051    IFunction duplicate;
052    Lock writeLock = instanceLock.writeLock();
053    writeLock.lock();
054    try {
055      NamedFunctionSet functions = libraryByQName.get(qname);
056      if (functions == null) {
057        functions = new NamedFunctionSet();
058        libraryByQName.put(qname, functions);
059      }
060      duplicate = functions.addFunction(function);
061    } finally {
062      writeLock.unlock();
063    }
064    if (duplicate != null) {
065      throw new IllegalArgumentException(String.format("Duplicate functions with same arity: %s shadows %s",
066          duplicate.toSignature(), function.toSignature()));
067    }
068  }
069
070  @Override
071  public Stream<IFunction> stream() {
072    Lock readLock = instanceLock.readLock();
073    readLock.lock();
074    try {
075      return ObjectUtils.notNull(libraryByQName.values().stream().flatMap(NamedFunctionSet::getFunctionsAsStream));
076    } finally {
077      readLock.unlock();
078    }
079  }
080
081  @Override
082  public IFunction getFunction(@NonNull IEnhancedQName name, int arity) {
083    IFunction retval = null;
084    Lock readLock = instanceLock.readLock();
085    readLock.lock();
086    try {
087      NamedFunctionSet functions = libraryByQName.get(name);
088      if (functions != null) {
089        retval = functions.getFunctionWithArity(arity);
090      }
091    } finally {
092      readLock.unlock();
093    }
094    return retval;
095  }
096
097  private static class NamedFunctionSet {
098    private final Map<Integer, IFunction> arityToFunctionMap;
099    private IFunction unboundedArity;
100
101    public NamedFunctionSet() {
102      this.arityToFunctionMap = new HashMap<>();
103    }
104
105    @SuppressWarnings("null")
106    @NonNull
107    public Stream<IFunction> getFunctionsAsStream() {
108      return arityToFunctionMap.values().stream();
109    }
110
111    @Nullable
112    public IFunction getFunctionWithArity(int arity) {
113      IFunction retval = arityToFunctionMap.get(arity);
114      if (retval == null && unboundedArity != null && unboundedArity.arity() < arity) {
115        retval = unboundedArity;
116      }
117      return retval;
118    }
119
120    @Nullable
121    public IFunction addFunction(@NonNull IFunction function) {
122      IFunction old = arityToFunctionMap.put(function.arity(), function);
123      if (function.isArityUnbounded()) {
124        unboundedArity = function;
125      }
126      return old;
127    }
128  }
129}
